info.title: PictoPy
info.description: The API calls to PictoPy are done via HTTP requests. This backend is built using FastAPI.

post.description: Enable AI tagging for multiple folders.
Disable AI tagging for multiple folders.

delete.description: Delete multiple folders by their IDs.

post.description: Sync a folder by comparing filesystem folders with database entries and removing extra DB entries.

get.description: Get details of all folders in the database.
Get all albums. Always returns both locked and unlocked albums.

post.description:
Copy a memory's photos into a new album.

The memory itself is left untouched, so the same one can be converted
again under a different name. Any clips are left behind: album_images
references images, and albums have no video support.

get.description: Get all images from the database.
Semantic search images by query text using SigLIP2.

post.description: Toggle the favorite status of an image.

get.description: Get all videos from the database.
Semantic search videos by query text using SigLIP2 keyframe embeddings.

post.description:
Delete the sampled keyframe JPEGs. Tags and semantic search survive:
only the on-disk frames are removed, not their embeddings.
Toggle the favorite status of a video.

put.description: Rename a face cluster by its ID.

get.description: Get metadata for all face clusters including face counts.
Get all images that contain faces belonging to a specific cluster.

post.description:
Manually trigger global face reclustering.
This forces full reclustering regardless of the 24-hour rule.
Search for images containing multiple face identities, ranked by match count.

Queue a curation run.

Returns immediately; the run itself goes to the shared single-worker
executor so it serializes behind indexing and semantic scoring rather than
racing them.

get.description:
Report scheduler state.

Polled by the Tauri background task, which is why indexing_busy is computed
here: the desktop shell never opens the database itself.

Get the memory to surface now, or null if there is nothing to show.

Having nothing to surface is a normal state for a small or new library, so
this returns 200 with a null payload rather than a 404.
List memory cards, newest first. Backs the history filmstrip and grid.

parameters.name: event_type

schema.description: Filter by anniversary, import_event or semantic_event
schema.title: Event Type

parameters.description: Filter by anniversary, import_event or semantic_event

get.description: Get a single memory with its full image set.

patch.description: Update a memory's viewed, dismissed or notified state.

delete.description: Delete a memory. Its curated image list cascades; the photos remain.

post.description:
Gracefully shutdown the PictoPy backend.

This endpoint schedules backend server termination after response is sent.
The frontend is responsible for shutting down the sync service separately.

Returns:
    ShutdownResponse with status and message

get.description:
Candidate addresses, best guess first.

Machines with virtual adapters routinely surface several, so the caller is
expected to show this list rather than silently trust the first entry.

post.description:
Issue a share token and make sure the network listener is up.

An album's local lock is deliberately not consulted: locking protects the
album inside PictoPy, while sharing carries its own authorization.

get.description: Returns the installation status of all models in the registry.
Returns hardware specs and the recommended model tier.

delete.description: Deletes a specific model from disk.

post.description:
Initializes setup by starting downloads for a specific tier + required models.
Returns a single task_id to track overall progress.
Starts download for a specific model by key. Returns a task_id.

get.description: Streams SSE progress for a given download task_id.

ErrorResponseEnvelope.title: ErrorResponseEnvelope
ErrorResponseEnvelope.description:
How an ErrorResponse actually reaches the client.

HTTPException nests whatever it is given under `detail`, so documenting
ErrorResponse alone would describe a shape no client ever receives.

GetTodayMemoryData.title: GetTodayMemoryData
GetTodayMemoryData.description:
The memory to surface now, if any.

`memory` is null rather than a 404 when nothing qualifies: this endpoint is
polled, and an empty library is a normal state, not an error.

ImageInCluster.description: Represents an image that contains faces from a specific cluster.

MemoriesPreferencesUpdate.title: MemoriesPreferencesUpdate
MemoriesPreferencesUpdate.description: Partial update for memories preferences; every field is optional.

MemoryCard.title: MemoryCard
MemoryCard.description: Memory summary, without the image set. Used by the history filmstrip.

MemoryImageItem.title: MemoryImageItem
MemoryImageItem.description: A single curated image within a memory.

MemoryScoringWeights.title: MemoryScoringWeights
MemoryScoringWeights.description:
Relative importance of each memory scoring signal.

Weights are normalized to sum to 1.0 on validation, so a UI slider set
never has to land on an exact total.

MemoryScoringWeightsUpdate.title: MemoryScoringWeightsUpdate
MemoryScoringWeightsUpdate.description:
Partial update for scoring weights.

Deliberately does not normalize: rescaling a single slider to 1.0 would
wipe out the others. Stored values stay raw and are normalized on read.

MemoryStatusData.title: MemoryStatusData
MemoryStatusData.description: Scheduler-facing snapshot. Polled by the Tauri background task.

MemoryStory.title: MemoryStory
MemoryStory.description: A memory with its full image set, for the story viewer.

MemoryVideoItem.title: MemoryVideoItem
MemoryVideoItem.description: A short clip curated into a memory, sharing the images' sort_order.
